User.description: Stores user profile settings and preferences

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of last sign in

JournalEntry.description: User journal entry with multi-turn AI reflections, summary, key insights, and tags

title.description: Title or topic of the journal reflection

category.description: Category (e.g. Daily Reflection, Career, Mindset, Creative, Gratitude)

mood.description: Optional mood indicator (e.g. calm, motivated, thoughtful, stressed, happy)

initialText.description: Original journal prompt or reflection text from user

location.description: Optional attached location tag with coordinates and address

attachments.description: Array of multimedia attachments (images, video, pdf)

summary.description: AI generated concise summary of reflection

keyInsights.description: AI identified key takeaways / action items

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when entry was started
